results.content: # Reflection. ## Private AI journal + coach with guides to help you flourish. ## Private AI journal + coach with guides to help you flourish. Reflection is a private, AI-powered journaling app designed to help you flourish. Reflection is available across all your devices, including iOS, Android, macOS, and a full-featured web app for journaling online. This is the 6th launch from Reflection. ## 2025 Annual Review. It's like Spotify Wrapped for Your Journal. This year we have completely reimagined the Annual Review. With a single click, Reflection instantly gathers your 2025 journal entries to generate a beautiful "first draft" of your year. Giving you a massive head start on your end-of-year reflection without the heavy lifting. Re-reading a year's worth of journal entries, your photos, your calendar... With a single click, our new Annual Review scans your 2025 entries and generates a "first draft" of your year. Think of it like Spotify Wrapped for your journal. Many journaling apps struggle because reflection still feels like a task. From an onboarding & retention perspective, what’s the moment when a user actually *feels* the reset, not just sees the prompts? We actually rolled out a feature a few months back where we show users insights right after they create an entry—stuff that connects to their past entries. Seeing those connections and getting a quick synthesis of their entry helps users feel the benefits immediately. I love the concept and great timing on bringing it on here one day after the wrapped came out of Spotify 🤣, but i do believe that for us to understand what's to come, it's very important to revisit the past, and i love how you're product helps the users do a context dive. The annual review starts with entries based on January and goes through to the end of December. Our goal here was to remove the friction, allow users to see the benefit, and then go back, edit, update, and enhance their annual review. ### Trending products.
